"""RoboCasa365 BeverageSorting live client controller.

This script only uses the robot's cameras, camera calibration, proprioception,
and native joint-position action interface. It deliberately does not call reset.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left",
           "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"]

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
DT = spec["control_dt"]
LAYOUT = spec["proprio_layout"]

def observe(cameras=CAMERAS, depth=True):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")

def command(q=None, grip=-1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0,
            mode=-1.0, seconds=0.5, cameras=CAMERAS, note=""):
    """Hold one native command for seconds (at most 10 per call)."""
    p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]
    now = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
    if q is None:
        q = np.array([now[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    row = np.r_[q, grip, base, torso, mode]
    out = r.submit("joint_position", np.tile(row, (n, 1)), dt=DT,
                   interpolate="hold", cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = observe()
    print(json.dumps({"spec": spec, "obs": o.meta}, indent=2))

"""RoboCasa365 BeverageSorting live client controller.

This script only uses the robot's cameras, camera calibration, proprioception,
and native joint-position action interface. It deliberately does not call reset.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left",
           "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"]

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
DT = spec["control_dt"]
LAYOUT = spec["proprio_layout"]

def observe(cameras=CAMERAS, depth=True):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")

def command(q=None, grip=-1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0,
            mode=-1.0, seconds=0.5, cameras=CAMERAS, note=""):
    """Hold one native command for seconds (at most 10 per call)."""
    p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]
    now = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
    if q is None:
        q = np.array([now[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)])
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    row = np.r_[q, grip, base, torso, mode]
    out = r.submit("joint_position", np.tile(row, (n, 1)), dt=DT,
                   interpolate="hold", cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)
    return out

def read_arm():
    p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]
    now = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
    q = np.array([now[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)], float)
    xyz = np.array([now["eef_right_x"], now["eef_right_y"], now["eef_right_z"]], float)
    return q, xyz

def hand_pose():
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=["robot0_eye_in_hand"], video="none")
    T = np.array(o.meta["cameras"]["robot0_eye_in_hand"]["cam2world_gl"], float)
    q, xyz = read_arm()
    return q, xyz, T[:3, :3]

def estimate_jacobian(eps=0.04):
    """Estimate end-effector translation and camera orientation Jacobian by safe joint dithers."""
    q0, _, _ = hand_pose()
    # Finish any residual servo motion before taking a local derivative.
    command(q=q0, grip=-1.0, seconds=2.0, cameras=[], note="settle before Jacobian estimate")
    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        # Rebase each column after restoring, because real joint servos can lag their targets.
        q0, p0, R0 = hand_pose()
        q1 = q0.copy(); q1[j] += eps
        command(q=q1, grip=-1.0, seconds=1.5, cameras=[], note=f"calibration dither joint {j+1}")
        q1_actual, p1, R1 = hand_pose()
        de = q1_actual[j] - q0[j]
        if abs(de) < eps * 0.25:
            command(q=q1, grip=-1.0, seconds=1.5, cameras=[], note=f"complete dither joint {j+1}")
            q1_actual, p1, R1 = hand_pose()
            de = q1_actual[j] - q0[j]
        if abs(de) < eps * 0.10:
            command(q=q0, grip=-1.0, seconds=1.5, cameras=[], note=f"restore failed dither joint {j+1}")
            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} did not track calibration dither ({de:.4f} rad)")
        J[:3, j] = (p1 - p0) / de
        J[3:, j] = Rotation.from_matrix(R1 @ R0.T).as_rotvec() / de
        command(q=q0, grip=-1.0, seconds=1.5, cameras=[], note=f"restore after dither joint {j+1}")
    return J

def move_eef(target_xyz, target_R=None, max_iter=18, grip=-1.0, note="Cartesian waypoint"):
    """Move with visual/proprioceptive finite-difference IK, keeping the wrist orientation."""
    target_xyz = np.asarray(target_xyz, float)
    if target_R is None:
        _, _, target_R = hand_pose()
    for iteration in range(max_iter):
        q, p, R = hand_pose()
        dp = target_xyz - p
        dr = Rotation.from_matrix(target_R @ R.T).as_rotvec()
        if np.linalg.norm(dp) < 0.012 and np.linalg.norm(dr) < 0.10:
            return {"q": q.tolist(), "eef": p.tolist(), "position_error": float(np.linalg.norm(dp)),
                    "rotation_error": float(np.linalg.norm(dr)), "iterations": iteration}
        # Keep each Cartesian update local so the measured Jacobian remains useful.
        dn = np.linalg.norm(dp)
        if dn > 0.04: dp *= 0.04 / dn
        rn = np.linalg.norm(dr)
        if rn > 0.12: dr *= 0.12 / rn
        J = estimate_jacobian()
        scale = 0.20  # metres per radian for balancing pose and translation
        JW = J.copy(); JW[3:, :] *= scale
        err = np.r_[dp, scale * dr]
        lam = 0.025
        dq = JW.T @ np.linalg.solve(JW @ JW.T + lam * lam * np.eye(6), err)
        peak = np.max(np.abs(dq))
        if peak > 0.05: dq *= 0.05 / peak
        command(q=q+dq, grip=grip, seconds=2.0, cameras=[], note=f"{note}: IK step {iteration+1}")
    q, p, R = hand_pose()
    return {"q": q.tolist(), "eef": p.tolist(), "position_error": float(np.linalg.norm(target_xyz-p)),
            "rotation_error": float(np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(target_R @ R.T).as_rotvec())),
            "iterations": max_iter}

ACTION_LOG = [
    "Connected to the single BeverageSorting episode; no reset was issued.",
    "Observed four drinks with the wrist and agent cameras. The two dark glass bottles were treated as alcoholic; the can and light plastic bottle as non-alcoholic.",
    "Opened the gripper and calibrated joint-to-wrist motion using small joint dithers and the reported camera transforms/proprioception.",
    "Moved above the counter, then descended toward a dark bottle. The arm contacted/displaced it and it ended up lying on the counter.",
    "Made two close-and-lift attempts on the fallen bottle. Camera images showed it remained on the counter; no successful grasp or cabinet placement was confirmed.",
    "Stopped issuing motion commands after the unsuccessful grasp attempts. The service remains the authority for the final graded state.",
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = observe()
    print(json.dumps({"spec": spec, "obs": o.meta, "action_log": ACTION_LOG}, indent=2))
